name: orbis-mobile
description: Orbis iOS and Android apps (Capacitor shell around https://tryorbis.app). See docs/MOBILE_APPS.md.

scripts.android:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

scripts.ios:open: cap sync ios && cap open ios
